spans.s:
f. (-त्या)
Killing a cow.
E.
गो, and हत्या murder.

n. (-न्नं)
Cowdung.
E.
गो and हन्न ordure.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Proper or fit for cattle.
2 Cherishing or protecting kine.
m. (-तः)
1 A creeping plant; also घोषा.
2 The Bel tree.
E.
गो a cow, and हित suitable, &c.

n. (-रं)
The heel.
E.
गूह to cover, इरन् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 To be covered or concealed.
2 To be kept secret.
E.
गूह to cover, ण्यत् aff.
